exposure: Fetal brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features
cohort: The study included 58 fetuses diagnosed prenatally with Vein of Galen aneurysmal malformations (VGAM) who had at least one fetal MRI, extracted from a prospectively assembled database.
finding: Prenatal MCA pseudofeeders were a risk factor for encephalomalacia at birth, and both MCA pseudofeeders and hydrocephalus were risk factors for severe cardiac failure and severe pulmonary hypertension at birth.
gest_age: Median gestational age at fetal MRI was 32.3 weeks of pregnancy (+-2.3)
